name: Rindou Kaoru
source:
Sumire's Right-Hand Woman

Kaoru of the Wind Division manages the theater's finances, but her main role is as Sumire's secretary. From behind the scenes, she battles bureaucracy.

[i]"Don't beg for more money if you can't stay under budget."[/i]

[From [url=https://games.sega.com/sakurawars/lang/en/]SEGA[/url]]
